questions.question_text: Which piecewise function represents $f(x) = \dfrac{x^2 - 25}{|x - 5|}$ in simplest form?

options.why: Included $x = 5$, where the original denominator is zero.
Used $|x - 5| = x - 5$ on both intervals, omitting the denominator's negation for $x < 5$.
Cancelled the numerator factor $x + 5$ instead of $x - 5$, leaving $x - 5$ in the upper branch and $-(x - 5)$ in the lower branch.

questions.solution_text:
$\text{Note } x^2 - 25 = (x - 5)(x + 5) \text{ and } x \neq 5.$
$\text{For } x > 5: |x - 5| = x - 5 \implies f(x) = \frac{(x - 5)(x + 5)}{x - 5} = x + 5$
$\text{For } x < 5: |x - 5| = -(x - 5) \implies f(x) = \frac{(x - 5)(x + 5)}{-(x - 5)} = -(x + 5) = -x - 5$
$f(x) = \begin{cases} x + 5, & \text{for } x > 5 \\ -x - 5, & \text{for } x < 5 \end{cases}$
